2607.06854.title: A Gold-Standard Study of What Makes a Lightweight Game-Playing Agent Strong
2607.06854.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning agents for imperfect-information card games are only as strong as the opponents they train against, and they are hard to grade, since they beat a random opponent over 99 percent of the time and only tie copies of themselves. So we build a strong, fixed, rule-based expert for Gin Rummy and use it only as a yardstick, never for training. It beats every agent we trained 70 to 99 percent of the time. Across more than a hundred runs, we isolate what makes a lightweight agent stronger. Trust region updates, a well-aimed reward, a curriculum of tougher opponents, warm starting, and keeping the best checkpoint all help, and stacking them lifts a self-play champion from about 30 to 36 percent against the expert. Several ideas did not pay off. Short-term and longer-term reward shaping, learned state embeddings, imitation and DAgger, and a live large language model opponent were each unhelpful, too slow, or too heavy to train at scale. Comparing MLP, convolutional, set-based, attention, and recurrent encoders shows that extra capacity does little to break the ceiling, suggesting the limit is information rather than network size. We add standard baselines (neural fictitious self-play and information set Monte Carlo search) and confirm the approach carries over to Leduc Hold'em, where the optimum is computable. The result is a lightweight, game-agnostic recipe that trains competitive agents without training on the expert, for any game a small model can handle, reported with robust statistics and released as a reusable package.
2607.06854.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習代理在不完美資訊的紙牌遊戲中，其實力僅取決於他們訓練的對手，而評估這些代理則非常困難，因為他們在99%以上的情況下能擊敗隨機對手，並且僅能與自己的複製品平手。<lb/>因此，我們為Gin Rummy建立了一個強大且固定的基於規則的專家，並僅將其用作衡量標準，而不進行訓練。<lb/>它在70%到99%的情況下擊敗我們訓練的每一個代理。<lb/>在超過一百次的運行中，我們找出了使輕量級代理變得更強的因素。<lb/>信任區域更新、精確的獎勵、更艱難對手的課程、熱啟動以及保留最佳檢查點都對提升有幫助，並且將它們疊加可以使自我對戰的冠軍在對抗專家時從約30%提升到36%。<lb/>幾個想法並沒有帶來回報。<lb/>短期和長期的獎勵塑造、學習的狀態嵌入、模仿和DAgger，以及一個大型語言模型的即時對手都各自無法提供幫助，或者速度太慢，或者訓練規模過於龐大。<lb/>比較MLP、卷積、基於集合的、注意力和循環編碼器顯示，額外的容量對突破上限幫助不大，這表明限制在於資訊而非網絡大小。<lb/>我們添加了標準基準（神經虛構自我對戰和資訊集蒙地卡羅搜索），並確認這種方法可以轉移到Leduc Hold'em，該遊戲的最佳解是可計算的。<lb/>結果是一個輕量級的、遊戲無關的配方，可以在不對專家進行訓練的情況下訓練具有競爭力的代理，適用於任何小模型能夠處理的遊戲，並以穩健的統計數據報告，釋放為可重用的包。
